item.title: 'Gun And Ball' Gamers Seething After 'Okami 2' Devs Call Them Out For 'The Game Awards' 2024 Reveal Criticism
item.description: Gun and Ball Gamer is a slang term describing someone who only plays video games that prominently features guns, such as FPS games, or balls, referring to sports games. The term is often used disparagingly to call someone's taste in video games basic. It has been used online since as early as June 2023, when X / Twitter user @LANDoCUH posted, "N****s when a video game ain't got guns or a ball in it" over a GIF of Patrick Star snoring. item.title: 'Yellow Font Theory' Goes Viral As TikTokers Get Emotional And Ironic
item.description: Yellow Font Theory or Yellow Font BTW is a slang term and theory claiming that yellow font is used in the captions of online content, usually short form videos, when a user is being emotionally vulnerable, honest and offering genuine, introspective thoughts. item.title: Influencer Mary Magdalene, Known For Her Extensive Body Modifications, Dies In Thailand After 'Haunting' Final Post
item.description: In mid-December 2025, Magdalene died when she fell from a high-rise apartment building in Patong, Thailand, with her death subsequently receiving widespread media coverage, as well as reactions on social media. Much of the discourse surrounding her death centered on what outlets called a "haunting" final post the day before her passing.

item.title: Tennessee State Trooper Behind 'Cassius Thundercock' Meme IDed Online, And His Chin Is Real
item.description: The clip of the police officer resurfaced on TikTok in August 2025 and went viral that November, inspiring the nickname "Cassius Thundercock" and memes in which people dress up as him and jokingly portray him as a cartoonishly crooked, aggressive cop who always turns his bodycam off to deal with people who wrong him. One of the most common jokes is that Cassius has had his bodycam turned off since Vietnam, meaning the Vietnam war.
